scope: Read-only adapter; no strategy outcomes or network
checks: Actual valid and sparse first-session rows preserve exact raw values
Missing request and missing continuation page remain explicit; known partial bars retained
Malformed/invalid/duplicate/out-of-session rows remain linked to raw source indices
Hash or entity-asof mismatch refuses source input
Existing early-close fixture is reused at exact offsets without synthetic rows
Generator order matches session order; audit callback receives every session
Failed request-attempt metadata references/hashes retained separately from minute gaps
